selected.rationale: 100% loss on home-timeline->post-storage stalls every home-timeline read for the 10s thrift timeout and then fails, exposing no retry/fallback on the highest-frequency read path.
Loss on compose-post->post-storage prevents persisting the post; ComposePost waits 10s and returns failure, confirming the write path has no degradation or retry for the durable-storage dependency.
Loss on compose-post->home-timeline makes the post-publish fan-out fail after the 10s timeout, leaving ambiguous partial state (post may be stored but timelines not updated) and no fallback/retry.
Unique-id is required to assemble a post; loss makes every compose-post request hang for the 10s timeout and fail, exposing lack of retry/fallback for a blocking write-path dependency.
Killing social-graph makes home-timeline reads fail (connection refused) because the followee graph is unavailable, exposing missing retry/fallback and no HA for this core read dependency.
Loss on compose-post->user-timeline blocks the user-profile timeline update; the 10s timeout then causes the post write to be reported failed, showing no retry or fallback for this write-path edge.
Loss on compose-post->user prevents user metadata retrieval, so every create-post request stalls 10s and fails, confirming missing retry/fallback on a required user-service dependency.
Loss on compose-post->text causes content processing to hang for the 10s timeout and then fail, exposing no fallback/retry for the text-service dependency in the write path.
